# PostgreSQL 18 REL_18_6

> Documentation generated from the `REL_18_6` maintenance-release tag of [postgres/postgres](https://github.com/postgres/postgres) and pinned to immutable source commit `724edf9bde9d356724ad384a2e196edc3c9f80f7`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for PostgreSQL 18 REL_18_6.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- PostgreSQL 18 tracks the highest `REL_18_<minor>` maintenance-release tag; betas and release candidates are ignored.
- DocBook XML sources are assembled from their declared entities and converted without executing the upstream Make, Meson, Perl, or XSLT toolchain.
- Error-code, wait-event, SQL-conformance, key-word, and Meson-target tables the upstream build generates are reproduced from the same checked-in data files.

## PostgreSQL Coding Conventions

- [Formatting](pages/source-format.md): Source code formatting uses 4 column tab spacing, with tabs preserved (i.e., tabs are not expanded to spaces). Each logical indentation level is one additional tab stop. (2072 bytes)
- [Reporting Errors Within the Server](pages/error-message-reporting.md): Error, warning, and log messages generated within the server code should be created using ereport, or its older cousin elog. The use of this function is complex enough to require some explanation. (10972 bytes)
- [Error Message Style Guide](pages/error-style-guide.md): This style guide is offered in the hope of maintaining a consistent, user-friendly style throughout all the messages generated by PostgreSQL. (10596 bytes)
- [Miscellaneous Coding Conventions](pages/source-conventions.md): Code in PostgreSQL should only rely on language features available in the C99 standard. That means a conforming C99 compiler has to be able to compile postgres, at least aside from a few platform dependent pieces. (3690 bytes)

## dblink — connect to other PostgreSQL databases

- [dblink_connect](pages/contrib-dblink-connect.md): opens a persistent connection to a remote database (4886 bytes)
- [dblink_connect_u](pages/contrib-dblink-connect-u.md): opens a persistent connection to a remote database, insecurely (1455 bytes)
- [dblink_disconnect](pages/contrib-dblink-disconnect.md): closes a persistent connection to a remote database (731 bytes)
- [dblink](pages/contrib-dblink-function.md): executes a query in a remote database (4896 bytes)
- [dblink_exec](pages/contrib-dblink-exec.md): executes a command in a remote database (2173 bytes)
- [dblink_open](pages/contrib-dblink-open.md): opens a cursor in a remote database (1781 bytes)
- [dblink_fetch](pages/contrib-dblink-fetch.md): returns rows from an open cursor in a remote database (2643 bytes)
- [dblink_close](pages/contrib-dblink-close.md): closes a cursor in a remote database (1293 bytes)
- [dblink_get_connections](pages/contrib-dblink-get-connections.md): returns the names of all open named dblink connections (390 bytes)
- [dblink_error_message](pages/contrib-dblink-error-message.md): gets last error message on the named connection (863 bytes)
- [dblink_send_query](pages/contrib-dblink-send-query.md): sends an async query to a remote database (969 bytes)
- [dblink_is_busy](pages/contrib-dblink-is-busy.md): checks if connection is busy with an async query (492 bytes)
- [dblink_get_notify](pages/contrib-dblink-get-notify.md): retrieve async notifications on a connection (1105 bytes)
- [dblink_get_result](pages/contrib-dblink-get-result.md): gets an async query result (3339 bytes)
- [dblink_cancel_query](pages/contrib-dblink-cancel-query.md): cancels any active query on the named connection (771 bytes)
- [dblink_get_pkey](pages/contrib-dblink-get-pkey.md): returns the positions and field names of a relation's primary key fields (1259 bytes)
- [dblink_build_sql_insert](pages/contrib-dblink-build-sql-insert.md): builds an INSERT statement using a local tuple, replacing the primary key field values with alternative supplied values (2362 bytes)
- [dblink_build_sql_delete](pages/contrib-dblink-build-sql-delete.md): builds a DELETE statement using supplied values for primary key field values (1813 bytes)
- [dblink_build_sql_update](pages/contrib-dblink-build-sql-update.md): builds an UPDATE statement using a local tuple, replacing the primary key field values with alternative supplied values (2589 bytes)
